command:
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
git fetch origin main --no-tags --prune
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "fetch main failed" }
if ((git rev-parse origin/main).Trim() -ne "d395db0f40b2a3863be4216ba1644f46f42c8dc0") { throw "main moved" }
$source = "C:\dev\flyExplorer\logs\m23"
$target = "C:\dev\flyExplorer\logs\remote-evidence"
$before = Join-Path $source "large-resident-window-before.png"
$after = Join-Path $source "large-resident-window-after.png"
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $before -PathType Leaf)) { throw "BEFORE screenshot missing" }
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $after -PathType Leaf)) { throw "AFTER screenshot missing" }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $target | Out-Null
Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $target -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Force
Copy-Item -LiteralPath $before -Destination (Join-Path $target "large-resident-window-before.png")
Copy-Item -LiteralPath $after -Destination (Join-Path $target "large-resident-window-after.png")
Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $before,$after |
  ForEach-Object { "$($_.Path) $($_.Hash)" } |
  Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 -LiteralPath (Join-Path $target "resident-window-sha256.txt")
Write-Host "RESIDENT_WINDOW_EVIDENCE_EXPORT_PASS"
